goal: Faithful standalone native C++ reconstruction of Lemmings Revolution using MinGW-w64 GCC; Emscripten comes later.
criteria: Both native source trees build with MinGW-w64 GCC and all registered source and retail-asset verification tests pass.
The standalone application integrates loading, frontend navigation, gameplay, rendering, input, results, persistent progress and audio without requiring the original executable at runtime.
Required fidelity gates in docs/STATUS.md are satisfied with scoped reference evidence, including gameplay timing and full-frame behavior; passing source tests alone is insufficient.
No required feature gaps, unresolved fidelity failures or user-parked completion dependencies remain. Any excluded scope has explicit user authorization.
execution_boundary: Original-game launches, original-byte oracles and user-parked work cannot be authorized or reopened by the controller. Stop with a concrete blocker when required.
